payload.what_is_unsupported: A conflict between two renderings issued in the same addendum (Arabic image reading vs English translation, ADD-03:T5-1) where neither is a target at ADD-02. No amend op type can record which datum governs for a table brought in by reference.
payload.why: The governing Arabic heading reads 'الحدّ الأقصى للارتفاع (متر فوق منسوب الأرض الطبيعية)' (metres above NATURAL ground level), while the English translation issued in the same addendum heads the column 'Maximum height (m above finished ground level)'. Clause 7.2 says 'The Arabic text governs.' The two renderings set different datums for every height limit in Table 5-1. The cell names no unit existing at ADD-02, so no op can carry this. The reading is still pending and its translation is only proposed, so a person must confirm the reading and decide how the datum conflict is recorded (for example as an issue or a clarification).
